mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all27 final medium-fi views across noon/late light, high/economy quality, identity views, silhouette and four matched levels. Surrounding hill is actual retained coarse PMTiles terrain. One sampler drives walls/routes at every level; reconstructed gate/summit floors are raised only where necessary to clear it, and wall/toe vertices reach sampled ground. Primary masses remain consistent.

geographicReview.notes: The inspected aerial picture supports pale summit wings, dark slate roofs, round turrets, entry tower and descending walls/gates. Retained east/south map geometry sets approximate location, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the hill; the derivative translates the old611.9699m first-gate study datum to the703.9600882109237m anchor datum, uses one retained PMTiles sampler for walls/routes at every level and raises reconstructed gate/summit floors only enough to clear coarse ground. No terrain mesh is embedded in the architecture. Anchor 14.452350896,46.755908856; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 703.9600882109237m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

fidelityReview.notes: Approximate exterior/hillside fit from inspected aerial picture and standard viewer PMTiles. The original611.9699m first-gate study datum translates to the703.9600882109237m anchor datum. Gate/floor and wall levels are reconstruction choices on coarse data. Individual ornament, archaeological detail, interiors, collision, vegetation, water simulation and terrain cutouts excluded. Footprint replacement stays off; physical-device timing unmeasured.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Castle-operator current exterior,upper court,gate and church descriptions/photos guide this original exterior.
